topic.title: Major Hazard Pipelines / PADHI / Development Consultation
topic.source_contract: pipeline identity and route, dangerous fluid, consultation distance and zones, proposed development sensitivity, HSE planning advice, local authority decision, pipeline operator consultation, construction controls and operational integrity evidence

scope_guards: A mapped pipeline is not treated as a verified current route.
A consultation distance is not treated as a mandatory exclusion zone.
A PADHI result is not treated as the planning decision.
Planning permission is not treated as a pipeline crossing agreement.
A crossing agreement is not treated as completed compliant works.
As-built separation is not treated as ongoing pipeline integrity.
No reported incident is not treated as measured safe operation.
No score or promotion is written without exact route, advice, decision, construction and integrity evidence.
